title: Ruins
body:
Removed
The following content has been removed from the game or does not exist.

Reason: Removed due to general user confusion and annoyance in v1.54.3

Description

The Ruins are a little structure that spawns on your property when you load a save for the first time.

The Ghost NPC will ask you a question where you can decide to keep it or to delete it.

Old save files will still contain this structure despite it being removed.

Trivia

  • The vine material is Kelp. It was Finlay Clover, filled with 5 Units, making a very big Finlay Clover schematic. This has patched Since 11/01/23 (v1.43.1), You can no longer obtain from this.
